_about: A set-up project as kickoff leaves it: a beginner building a portfolio site. scripts/measure-cost.mjs runs Claude Code in a copy of it. The plan is in English, so the headline figure does not depend on one language - a plan in a language that takes more tokens per word costs more. The CLAUDE.md here must look like what kickoff step 6 now writes - update it when that guidance changes.

files.CLAUDE.md:
# Portfolio — graphic designer

A portfolio site that a graphic designer sends to companies with job applications.
The user writes in English and is not a programmer. Reply in plain words.
Stack: plain HTML and CSS, no build step. Preview over HTTP (`python -m http.server`), not `file://`.
